known.via: English Wikipedia "Aglianico del Vulture" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A red wine from the Aglianico grape, grown on volcanic soils from Mount Vulture in Basilicata. It became a DOC.
